mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in total demand (GDPC1) over the past 12 months signals robust economic growth, which compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05 over any 6-month window, or 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite rising GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4.5% signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS remaining below 4.5% for >30 days, or spillover effects from other sectors negate the signal.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly growth in total demand (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) signals robust economic expansion, amplifying equity valuation increases and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), sustained increases in the federal funds rate compress discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS remaining above 4.5% for >30 days, or spillover effects from other sectors offset the signal.
